title: ⚒ Mora Village
summary: A system that enchants various equipment with Mora Coins.

blocks.text: A system that enchants various equipment with Mora Coins.
In Mora Village you can buy equipment with Mora Coins and enchant it in many ways.
The core enchant content for job equipment, Ur equipment, White Wing equipment and more.

blocks.title: Buying Mora Equipment
blocks.text: The enchantable Mora Village equipment can be exchanged for 10 Mora Coins.
Equipment that used to be random, such as the Bishop's Light of Cure set, can now be chosen and bought directly.

blocks.title: No More Failure Penalty
blocks.text: The equipment destruction and enchant reset penalties of the 2nd~4th slot enchants have been removed.

blocks.title: Same Enchant Cap for Every Slot
blocks.text: Every slot now has the same maximum enchant value.
The maximum enchant value used to depend on the slot; now the highest enchant can be obtained in every slot.
For example, [ITEM:2883|Ur Seal], [ITEM:2890|White Wing Brooch] and others can get the SP 150 option in several slots.
The enchantable Mora Village equipment can be exchanged for 10 Mora Coins.
